app_name: Lumina Estates - AI Real Estate Marketplace

image_urls.description: Luxurious modern penthouse living room with panoramic view
Modern luxury villa exterior with infinity pool
Man in a modern luxury apartment with urban skyline view
Stylish dining room with large windows overlooking cityscape

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure strict MERN stack compliance with React.js frontend, Node.js + Express.js backend, MongoDB database.
Integrate Google Gemini AI for natural-language property search, AI price/comparable analysis, risk detection, and investment insights.
Implement JWT authentication supporting Buyer and Seller roles with seeded demo accounts and registration.
Include wishlist, comparison drawer, property CRUD, search filters, and real-time messaging between buyers and sellers.
Apply all E1 design principles: generous spacing, luxury dark architecture aesthetic with gold accents, Bento asymmetric grids, and data-testid on all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Always use data-testid on all interactive elements, buttons, inputs, and links.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for headers or dropdowns without backdrop blur.
Use generous padding p-6 or p-8 on card containers.
Ensure high contrast and responsive layouts.
